title: Explore a new class: vortex dipoles in a 2D fluid whose vorticity is amplified only by eating a regrowing fuel (no gravity, no imposed direction)
summary: Following my audit of the reacting thermals (their motion is buoyant drift in imposed gravity), try a gravity-free fluid where the vorticity itself is the body and grows only where it consumes a fuel: vortex dipoles self-propel by self-induction in a direction they set, eat a trail, and may split. One-loop screen, sighting if anything life-like appears.
